ui_boundary.initial_page_load: The only enabled control is an explicit localized local-model inspection button. It does not fetch copy, inspect a model, poll, verify, start a worker or download.
ui_boundary.after_inspect: The portal obtains its same-locale static copy and one same-origin lifecycle status snapshot. It renders text-only disclosure, status and only deliberate lifecycle controls.
ui_boundary.progress: Only an accepted explicit lifecycle operation triggers bounded same-origin status polling; installation progress is bytes and percentage, never a model/chat claim.
ui_boundary.conversation: The standalone M10-02 dialogue controls remain disabled. This UI itself never renders chat, retrieval, answers, web evidence or ordinary-search changes. When an explicitly configured M12B/M12A assistant invokes the same verified installation operation, the application may attempt its reviewed post-verification local runtime preparation; a preparation failure preserves the verified model and exposes only a safe state.

admission: actual streamed body cap of 1024 bytes
strict Pydantic schema with extra fields forbidden
exact same-origin JSON POST and host rejection
api_boundary.operation: One daemon lifecycle operation is serialized for the selected fixed artifact. Install cancellation is cooperative, leaves only the fixed non-runnable partial artifact and can resume through the verified M6 flow.

removal: Removal reaches only the M6 fixed manifest-owned model, staging and quarantine locations and is possible only after a separate explicit confirmation.
